name: selection_identities_v1
role: SELECTION: best-epoch selection during fine-tuning only. Excluded from every calibration/test protocol.

provenance.POOL: the 750 Market-1501 test identities of artifacts/original/query_embeddings.npz MINUS pid 1488 (749 ids)
provenance.why_1488_is_missing: the pre-fix filename regex rejected '*.jpg.jpg'; all 1488 images use that extension, so the training code's folder-derived pool had 749 ids
provenance.why_frozen: checkpoints A1_ce_finetune, B_ce_triplet_all and C_ce_triplet_hard selected their best epoch on exactly these ids (their split.json). Re-deriving over 750 ids gives a different set (74/100 overlap) and would leak 26 selection ids into calibration/test.
